c.v: Which angle is a right angle?
Angle P
Angle Q
Angle R
Angle S
A right angle is a square corner, like the corner of a book. Angle S is a right angle.
Which of these has a right angle?
The tip of a sharp pencil
The point of a party hat
The corner of a page in a book
The edge of a round plate

A right angle is a square corner. The corner of a page in a book is a right angle. A sharp pencil tip and a party hat come to a point that is smaller than a right angle, and a round plate has no corners.
How many right angles are there in the rectangle above?
Each corner of a rectangle is a right angle. There are 4 corners, so there are 4 right angles.
How many of these angles are right angles?
Angles P, R and S are square corners, so they are right angles. Angle Q is smaller than a right angle. There are 3 right angles.

familyTitle: Is angle Z a right angle

c.v: Is angle Z a right angle? Write Yes or No.
Angle Z is a square corner, like the corner of a book. Yes, it is a right angle.

familyTitle: Is angle W a right angle

c.v: Is angle W a right angle? Write Yes or No.
Angle W opens wider than a square corner, so it is not a right angle. The answer is No.
Mrs Lim has 6 rectangular tiles. How many right angles are there in all 6 tiles altogether?
A rectangle has 4 right angles.
There are 24 right angles altogether.

Multiplies to get 24

Angle P

Angle P
Angle Q
Angle R
Angle S
Compare each angle with a square corner. Angle Q opens less than a right angle. Angle R is a right angle. Angles P and S open wider than a right angle.

familyTitle: Count angles smaller than a right angle

c.v: How many of these angles are smaller than a right angle?
Angles P and R are smaller than a right angle. Angles Q and S are greater than a right angle. The answer is 2.

familyTitle: Compare angle X with a right angle

c.v: Is angle X greater than, smaller than or the same as a right angle? Write your answer in words.
Angle X opens wider than a square corner, so it is greater than a right angle.
Write P, Q and R in order, starting with the smallest angle.
Angle P is the smallest. Angle R is a little bigger. Angle Q opens the widest.
From smallest to greatest: P, R, Q.

partialMarks.criterion: Identifies P as the smallest or Q as the greatest
All three in the correct order P, R, Q

familyTitle: Two angles with a right angle

c.v: Compare angle P and angle Q with a right angle. Which sentence is correct?
Both angles are smaller than a right angle.
Both angles are greater than a right angle.
Angle P is smaller than a right angle and angle Q is greater than a right angle.
Angle P is greater than a right angle and angle Q is smaller than a right angle.
Angle P is smaller than a right angle. Angle Q opens wider than a right angle, so it is greater.

familyTitle: Draw an angle greater than a right angle

c.v: Draw a line from point O to make an angle that is greater than a right angle.

accepted: A line from O going up and to the left, so the angle opens wider than a square corner (for example from O to the dot 2 to the left and 2 up).

c.v: A right angle is a square corner, so a line straight up from O would make a right angle. To make a greater angle, lean the line to the left. Example: draw from O up and to the left.

partialMarks.criterion: The new line starts at O
The angle made is greater than a right angle (the line leans to the left of straight up)

c.v: Which angle is the greatest?
Angle P
Angle Q
Angle R
Angle S
The size of an angle depends on how wide it opens, not on how long its lines are. Angle Q opens the widest, so it is the greatest angle.
Which sentence about an angle is correct?
An angle is a straight line that never ends.
An angle is the length of two lines.
An angle is formed when two straight lines meet at a point.
An angle is a curved line that meets at a point.
An angle is formed when two straight lines meet at a point.

familyTitle: Longer lines do not mean bigger angle

c.v: Amy says angle P is greater than angle Q because the lines of angle P are longer. Is Amy correct? Write Yes or No.
The size of an angle depends on how wide it opens, not on the length of its lines. Angle Q opens wider than angle P, so Amy is not correct.
Mei faces the school gate. She turns a quarter turn to face the canteen. What kind of angle has she turned through? Write: right angle, smaller than a right angle, or greater than a right angle.
A quarter turn is a turn through a square corner. So Mei has turned through a right angle.
Write P, Q and R in order, starting with the smallest angle.
Ignore how long the lines are. Look at how wide each angle opens. Angle Q opens the least, angle P more, and angle R the most.
From smallest to greatest: Q, P, R.

partialMarks.criterion: Compares the openings, not the length of the lines
All three in the correct order Q, P, R

c.v: A triangle has 3 angles. How many angles are there in 5 triangles?
Each triangle has 3 angles.
There are 15 angles in 5 triangles.
Which sentence about angle P and angle Q is correct?
Angle P is greater than angle Q.
Angle Q is greater than angle P.
Angle P and angle Q are the same size.
We cannot compare the angles.
Angle Q has longer lines, but both angles open by the same amount. The lines can be made longer without changing the size of the angle. So angle P and angle Q are the same size.
Which line is perpendicular to line P?
Line Q
Line R
Line S
Line T
Perpendicular lines meet at a right angle (a square corner). Line Q crosses line P at a right angle, so line Q is perpendicular to line P.
Which line is parallel to line Q?
Line P
Line R
Line S
Line T
Parallel lines are always the same distance apart and never meet. Line R stays the same distance from line Q all the way, so line R is parallel to line Q.

familyTitle: Pairs of parallel lines in a rectangle

c.v: How many pairs of parallel lines are there in the figure above?
Line P is parallel to line Q. Line R is parallel to line S. There are 2 pairs of parallel lines.
How many pairs of perpendicular lines are there in the figure above?
Line R meets line P at a right angle: 1 pair.
Line R meets line Q at a right angle: 1 pair.
Lines P and Q are parallel, not perpendicular. There are 2 pairs of perpendicular lines.

partialMarks.criterion: Finds at least one pair of perpendicular lines (R with P, or R with Q)
Finds both pairs and gives 2

c.v: Which line is perpendicular to both line P and line Q? Write the letter of the line.
Lines P and Q are parallel and stand straight up. Line R crosses both of them at right angles, so line R is perpendicular to both.
Which two lines are parallel? Write the letters of the two lines.
Line P and line R are always the same distance apart, so they are parallel. Line Q leans and line S has a different slope, so neither is parallel to another line.
Which sentence about a square is correct?
All four sides are parallel to one another.
Opposite sides are parallel.
Neighbouring sides are parallel.
No two sides are perpendicular.
Opposite sides of a square are always the same distance apart, so they are parallel. Neighbouring sides meet at a right angle, so they are perpendicular, not parallel.

familyTitle: Draw a parallel line through X

c.v: Draw a line through point X that is parallel to line AB.

accepted: A straight horizontal line through X, along the same row of dots as X (the same direction as AB).

c.v: Line AB is flat (horizontal). A parallel line stays the same distance from AB, so draw a flat line through X along the row of dots.
Draw a straight line from point X to line AB so that it is perpendicular to line AB.

accepted: A straight vertical line from X straight down to line AB (along the column of dots).

c.v: Perpendicular means meeting at a right angle. Draw straight down from X along the column of dots until you reach AB.
Draw a line through point Y that is perpendicular to line CD.

accepted: A straight horizontal line through Y, crossing CD at a right angle (along the row of dots).

c.v: Line CD stands straight up. A line that meets it at a right angle is flat (horizontal). Draw a flat line through Y along the row of dots.

familyTitle: Draw a parallel to a slanted line

c.v: Draw a line through point X that is parallel to line AB.

accepted: A slanted line through X going up to the right in the same way as AB (each step: one dot across and one dot up), for example from X to the dot 3 across and 3 up.

c.v: Line AB goes up 1 dot for every 1 dot across. A parallel line must lean the same way. Start at X and keep going 1 across and 1 up.

partialMarks.criterion: The line passes through X
The line leans the same way as AB (parallel to it)

c.v: A, B and D are three corners of rectangle ABCD. Draw the other two sides of the rectangle.

accepted: Two lines drawn: one from B straight up to the corner C (level with D), and one from D straight across to C. C is above B and to the right of D.

c.v: Opposite sides of a rectangle are parallel. So the side from B goes straight up, parallel to AD, and the side from D goes straight across, parallel to AB. They meet at C.

partialMarks.criterion: Draws the side from B parallel to AD (straight up)
Draws the side from D parallel to AB (straight across) so the sides meet at C

familyTitle: Why does the bar look shorter

c.v: Ken collected more stickers in Week 2 than in Week 1, but his bar looks shorter in the Week 2 graph. Why?
Ken collected fewer stickers in Week 2.
The Week 2 graph goes up in bigger steps.
The Week 2 graph is drawn wrongly.
The bars in the Week 2 graph are thinner.

Ken's bar is at 6 in Week 1 (scale of 2) and at 10 in Week 2 (scale of 10). Ten is more than 6, but each step in Week 2 is worth 10, so the same number of stickers makes a shorter bar. Always check the scale before comparing bars from different graphs.
